title: Salidroside alleviates liver inflammation in furan-induced mice by regulating oxidative stress and endoplasmic reticulum stress.
authors: Yuan, Yuan; Wang, Ziyue; Nan, Bo; Yang, Chaoyue; Wang, Minghua; Ye, Haiqing; Xi, Chunyu; Zhang, Yan; Yan, Haiyang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究红景天苷对呋喃诱导小鼠肝炎症的缓解机制，聚焦氧化应激和内质网应激通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Furan is a genotoxic and carcinogenic toxicant formed during the food thermal processing. Our previous studies confirmed that salidroside (SAL) displayed excellent protective effects against furan-induced hepatotoxicity and inflammation, whereas the underlying mechanism was still unclear. In the current study, Balb/c mice were divided to the control group (CON), the furan model group (FUR8, 8 mg/kg BW furan for 30 days) and SAL intervention groups (SAL10/20/40, 8 mg/kg BW furan for 30 days + 10/20/40 mg/kg BW SAL from day 16 to day 30). The alleviative effects and the mechanisms of SAL against furan-induced liver inflammation in mice were investigated through oxidative stress (OS) and endoplasmic reticulum stress (ERS). Liver metabonomics data, molecular docking and Western-blotting results implied that SAL suppressed the activity and the high expression of hepatic CYP2E1, and alleviated liver OS induced by furan. Levels of key markers (GRP78, CHOP and Caspase-12) of ERS and proteins in IRE1alpha pathway of the UPR branch increased by furan were prominently reduced after SAL treatment. Levels of phosphorylated proteins JNK, ERK, p38, IKKalpha/beta, IkappaB and p65 in MAPK and NF-kappaB pathways were also suppressed by SAL. We further confirmed that SAL inhibited furan-induced inflammation by reducing the levels of NLRP3, ASC, Cleaved Caspase-1 and IL-1beta and decreasing the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines. Our results shed light into the alleviating mechanisms behind furan-induced liver inflammation, and suggested that SAL inhibited OS, ERS and related MAPK and NF-kappaB pathways and therefore inhibited the NLRP3 inflammasome activation, which may be its potential mechanism of alleviating liver inflammation.
abstract_zh: 呋喃是一种在食品热加工过程中形成的基因毒性和致癌性毒物。我们先前的研究证实，红景天苷（SAL）对呋喃诱导的肝毒性和炎症表现出优异的保护作用，但其潜在机制尚不清楚。在本研究中，Balb/c小鼠被分为对照组（CON）、呋喃模型组（FUR8，8 mg/kg体重呋喃，持续30天）和SAL干预组（SAL10/20/40，8 mg/kg体重呋喃，持续30天，并在第16至第30天给予10/20/40 mg/kg体重SAL）。通过氧化应激（OS）和内质网应激（ERS）研究了SAL对呋喃诱导的小鼠肝脏炎症的缓解作用及其机制。肝脏代谢组学数据、分子对接和Western-blotting结果表明，SAL抑制了肝脏CYP2E1的活性和高表达，并缓解了呋喃诱导的肝脏OS。呋喃升高的ERS关键标志物（GRP78、CHOP和Caspase-12）以及UPR分支IRE1α通路中蛋白的水平，在SAL处理后显著降低。MAPK和NF-κB通路中磷酸化蛋白JNK、ERK、p38、IKKα/β、IκB和p65的水平也受到SAL的抑制。我们进一步证实，SAL通过降低NLRP3、ASC、Cleaved Caspase-1和IL-1β的水平以及减少促炎细胞因子的产生，抑制了呋喃诱导的炎症。我们的结果揭示了呋喃诱导肝脏炎症的缓解机制，并表明SAL抑制了OS、ERS及相关MAPK和NF-κB通路，从而抑制了NLRP3炎症小体的激活，这可能是其缓解肝脏炎症的潜在机制。
